scope: Public same-origin sitemap and static internal links; not all unlinked/dynamic content

statusDefinitions.reviewed_main_text: Main text read; not a full factual audit, no implied content license
statusDefinitions.reviewed_sections: Selected substantive sections read; remainder still open
statusDefinitions.not_reviewed: HTTP/link inventory only, no substantive content review

excluded.reason: Separate application not in editorial review scope; no login or interaction
Not counted as separate content pages
Dynamic binding parser artifacts, not verified page URLs
Utility page discovered from broken-link response, not a content candidate

method: Node HTTPS fetch, two workers, 180 ms pause per worker. Sitemap URLs then extra static links. HTML discarded after status/link/canonical extraction. Web main-text review only for explicitly marked entries. HTTP 200 alone is not a content or completeness check. Sitemap canonical values were not retained.
